title: Non-blocking finding from PR #281's review (backend-static-verify-cleanup-followups)

Purely a wording nit -- no functional or code impact, and the step's substance (run ruff --fix, confirm no behavior change) is accurate regardless of the finding-type label. If revisited: append a further `decisions` entry to `docs/tasks/done/backend-static-verify-cleanup.json` noting the checklist-item-1 wording is imprecise for the same reason as the already-corrected description text, per CLAUDE.md's append-only decisions-correction convention (do not edit the checklist text in place unless a task explicitly calls for it).
